reviewItem.question: Does "Tracing: In v3, the tracing feature has been revamped and is now powered exclusively by OpenTelemetry (OTel)" mean a change to protocol-behavior:traefik|name=tracing-vendor-output-formats (removed)?

proposed.statement: Traefik v3 tracing is OpenTelemetry-only; direct vendor output formats (Instana, Jaeger, Zipkin, Haystack, Datadog, Elastic) are no longer supported.
